scope: Research Track A. Actual public source inspection with explicit no-local-runtime qualification.
source_gate: Parent announced complete shared source processing before this research began.
global_limitations: No repository code, published binary or game process was executed in this audit.
Only the enumerated paths and ranges were inspected. Caching or tree enumeration is not full source reading.
Direct git network access failed because the execution environment could not connect to its proxy. GitHub connector supplied read-only primary-source access.
Initial general GitHub fetch of job-log URL was not allowed. Purpose-built job-log retrieval succeeded.
Research cache code and CI logs are excluded from the planning deliverable.

evidence.title: Setup architecture and license
evidence.claim: The desktop is Tauri with React and Rust. The portable Rust core exposes read-only ProjectFs and source adapters. Desktop scanner and transaction services remain outside that portable crate. Original source is Apache-2.0 and bundled dependencies retain their licenses.
evidence.reuse_decision: Reuse portable core and wrap desktop services behind C-09. Do not claim an existing general public onboarding API.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: S01 extraction and packaging probe. Preserve Apache notices and inspect dependency closure before distribution.

evidence.title: Actual wizard routes and controls
evidence.claim: Create and import share the wizard after initial identity or scan review. Current route includes coding environments, image generation, components, workflows, conditional Live Tools and Meshy, conditional MCP, Git, dry run, install and ready. Identity and Git controls are concrete existing UI.

Lines 1-240 including typed TauriCommandMap and invocation wrappers

evidence.reuse_decision: Adapt the existing route and controls, with progressive disclosure. Preserve provider analysis and review invariants.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Do not conflate source HEAD route with v0.6.3 released binary. Verify skipped optional routes and back navigation in native integration.

evidence.title: Read-only import scanner
evidence.claim: The scanner binds the chosen root identity, has bounded traversal and source retention, reports limits and supports cancellation. Parent-directory launcher descriptors are discovered within bounds and require explicit approval before use.

evidence.reuse_decision: Reuse scanner facts, coverage and root binding as C-01 inputs.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: S02 needs workshop-sized and dirty Git fixtures, cancellation, symlink/root swap, case collision and incomplete scan handling.

evidence.title: Assistant analysis and source closure
evidence.claim: Setup requires a provider analysis session before building an install plan. Source files are selected from a resolved manifest dependency closure and verified by expected hashes. A provider proposal does not authorize filesystem mutations.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Bridge factory model/auth service through the existing bounded analysis contract. Current Agentic manifest may resolve older components than audited latest repository HEAD.

evidence.title: Plan outputs and conflict ownership
evidence.claim: New plans generate descriptor.mod, a launcher .mod, thumbnail, README, setup state and merged ignore policy plus selected components. Existing modified paths are skipped or treated as conflicts. Core stores prepared plan bytes and application requires approval and dry-run review.

source_files.inspected: Entire README and managed gitignore generation

evidence.reuse_decision: Reuse exact plans and explicit conflict decisions. Adapt gitignore policy deliberately because generated guidance is currently ignored.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: No blanket overwrite. Verify existing descriptor, user AGENTS, changed managed skills, external launcher path and unsupported merge base cases.

evidence.title: Desktop transaction and recovery states
evidence.claim: The transaction validates root identity and source bytes, writes durable plan and journal state, stages and validates, applies, runs reviewed post-install work and readiness, then writes the success lock. Verified staging may resume before apply. Partial apply refuses resume and requires rollback. Finalizing state can reconcile.

evidence.reuse_decision: Wrap actual allowed recovery actions, do not invent universal resume.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Resolve exact-head CI recovery failure in SRC-A09. Filesystem final_live_verification is not actual gameplay validation.

evidence.title: Lifecycle tests and maintenance preservation
evidence.claim: The inspected offline lifecycle test covers create, import, repair, managed removal and rollback. It preserves a user gameplay file, modified managed skill and explicitly retained AGENTS. Update requires fresh maintenance analysis. Repair does not unconditionally require that same update-only guard.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Run lifecycle against the selected actual Agentic manifest closure and test interrupted native desktop recovery. Inspected tests are not proof of execution.

evidence.title: Browser export differs from desktop transaction
evidence.claim: The web export creates a reviewed ZIP. It can validate verified merge-base bytes and perform structured JSON/TOML or text three-way merges. It reports remaining user actions. Export is not native in-place installation.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Test generated ZIP independently and preserve readiness actions. Do not advertise desktop credentials or installation guarantees for browser export.

Candidate acceptance (recovery), Windows job 118160257466, reached recovery-without-provider and failed with 'The project was not restored exactly.' The log reports unequal actual and expected inventory hashes. Most other named CI jobs passed. Root cause has not been established.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Reproduce exact candidate, recover failed artifact, compare path inventories, identify whether implementation or acceptance fixture caused mismatch, fix and rerun before declaring recovery accepted.

evidence.title: MCP product boundary and tool surface
evidence.claim: Agent Tools 4.3.0 is a TypeScript MCP server with local stdio and authenticated HTTP. It supplies reference, source lookup, validation, focus, GUI, map, event, technology, probability, impact and mechanic surfaces. Event and technology tools are read-only. Mod mutations retain internal plan and atomic recovery rather than exposing apply tokens to agents.

evidence.reuse_decision: Wrap typed tools and reuse shared cores. Keep native factory UI outside this server's product boundary.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Discover tools and schemas at runtime. Document capability gaps and protocol-version fallback rather than assume every client supports tasks.

evidence.title: Source preservation and internal transaction execution
evidence.claim: Parser retains source bytes, token ranges and source hash. No-op serialization returns original bytes. Span rewrites preserve untouched source and original supported encoding. Unsafe syntax blocks rewrites. The transaction executor validates, binds a request to the prepared transaction, applies, validates after application and rolls back on failure.

tests/unit/core-source.test.ts lines 1-180 read, BOM/CRLF, Windows-1252 and malformed syntax
evidence.reuse_decision: Preferred preservation foundation after adapter tests. Bind final normalized arguments and path hashes in C-02/C-04.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Prove unsupported encoding refusal, duplicate keys, unknown raw blocks, concurrent edits and multi-file crash recovery on chosen host OS.

evidence.title: Focus authoring and preview evidence
evidence.claim: Public focus inspect/render/rewrite tools have typed source and output contracts. Renders return linked PNG, SVG, HTML, JSON and source-map artifacts. Large-workflow test source creates 1024 focuses, compacts, repeats compaction unchanged, inspects and renders through an in-memory MCP client. This is test intent, not a measured benchmark in this audit.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Benchmark actual project scale and validate source-map freshness. Preserve plan sidecar as derived planning data, with source authoritative.

evidence.title: Map capabilities and structured geography limitation
evidence.claim: Map service has hash-bound plans, semantic diffs, read-only previews, bounded geography input and linked artifacts. Geography-model preview exists but actual synthesis from that model is explicitly unavailable. Reference-image generation and procedural output tests are separate capabilities and do not establish game-ready worlds.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: S07 tests complete load order, replace_path, IDs, raster palette, topology and dependent references. Full world generation requires additional separately scoped game validation.

evidence.title: Source interpretation is not game simulation
evidence.claim: Mechanic and scenario tools interpret declared source steps. Unknown effects or unknown write sets leave assertions unresolved. Advancing modeled days only expires modeled timed flags. Package checks validate declarations and references, not execution of required cases.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Add tiny known scenarios and counterexamples against actual HOI4 observations before upgrading individual semantics.

evidence.title: HTTP authorization and session boundaries
evidence.claim: HTTP supports OAuth/OIDC principal and workspace grants with read and write scopes. Static bearer-token mode grants both read and write. Source contains host/origin checks and credential-bound sessions. Inspected integration test rejects writes for a read-only token and rejects session takeover with a replacement credential.

Replacement-token session takeover refusal
evidence.reuse_decision: Prefer local stdio for the first local app. Treat remote HTTP as a separate supported capability with explicit grant and origin configuration.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: This is a targeted source review, not a full security audit or penetration test. Test revocation, request normalization and task ownership through the factory.

evidence.title: Agent Tools license, dependencies and CI
evidence.claim: Original source is Apache-2.0. Notices separately identify Roboto OFL-1.1 and Tesseract engine/model licenses. Repository CI for the audited HEAD reports success.
evidence.reuse_decision: Pin the full installed dependency closure and retain notices. Load game assets from the user's installation.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Do not claim a source license clears third-party artwork. No runtime package installation or game test performed here.

evidence.claim: Native Rust runtime is presently implemented for Linux and bound to an exact executable build ID and SHA-256. Unsupported builds and native Windows/macOS adapters fail closed. Protocol capability output reports explicit unavailable and unverified observations, FAIR default, no native mod-QA path and a quarantined native game-command posting path.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Run actual supported-build smoke tests in an owned isolated campaign. Published Python v1.1.0 does not establish current Rust HEAD behavior.

evidence.title: Live action journal and uncertain effects
evidence.claim: Ordinary pause/speed actions record dispatch durably before sending and need observed target state before verification. Verified receipts are historical and idempotent across restarts. Uncertain dispatch blocks replays and new IDs for the same game process. Bounded-wait tests reject observations arriving after the deadline.

evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Do not equate a previously verified receipt with fresh current state. Factory timeout must not infer that action had no effect.

evidence.title: HOI4 rule pack and limits
evidence.claim: MIT CWT rule pack defines focus types, relationships, relative positions, trigger/effect scopes and localization. README acknowledges variable and array false positives. The inspected Python completeness helper compares effect names against bundled documentation. The visible workflow dispatches cache generation and is not a complete semantic test suite.
tests_inspected: Effect coverage comparison script inspected, not executed
evidence.reuse_decision: Pin rule SHA separately from CWTools engine and game/DLC profile. Track baseline and newly introduced diagnostics.
evidence.gaps_and_next_experiments: Refresh with game changes. Do not globally suppress or blindly fail on every rule warning. Inspect provenance of embedded documentation before redistribution.

evidence.title: Modmaker editing and map comparison
evidence.claim: Python/Tkinter/Pillow desktop offers useful focus and map interaction examples. Data layer overlays mod files onto base files and discards stale asynchronous results. Targeted focus/state edits decode utf-8-sig with errors ignored and rewrite utf-8 through normal text I/O, so comments claiming byte preservation are broader than implementation guarantees. Backups are one-time .bak and writes are not a multi-file durable transaction.
